info.title: Knotopian Institute of Technology (KIT) College System
info.description: Backend API for the Knotopian Institute of Technology (KIT) Dummy College System. Supports sandbox-isolated college data access, student & teacher workflows, placement registrations, admissions, and document downloads.

get.description: Check if the KIT College System API is running and reachable.
Retrieve the current date, weekday number (1=Mon ... 7=Sun), and IST timezone.
Retrieve official college name, description, accreditation, and admissions office contact.
Retrieve degree programmes, minimum 12th marks criteria, fee structure, and available seats.
